title: unbranded validate --json
description: The unit-definition validation report. One entry per definition read: a lone .json file or a directory with a unit.json yields one, a units directory yields one per child. `ok` is true only when every entry is ok. An issue with code `unsupported-schema` means the definition was written against a newer unit schema than this unbranded understands, which is an upgrade prompt rather than an authoring mistake.
